attributes.name: ypy-lazy
attributes.description: The URL of a GET request made when the element is about to be seen; the response replaces the element (`ypy-swap` changes that). The content of the element is the placeholder.

attributes.name: ypy-lazy-placeholder
attributes.description: A selector of a `<template>` (or element) whose content replaces the children of the region when it is processed.

attributes.name: ypy-lazy-error
attributes.description: A selector of a `<template>` (or element) whose content replaces the children of the region when it fails to load.

attributes.name: ypy-lazy-retry
attributes.description: On an element inside a lazy region: loads the region again when clicked after an error.

events.name: ypy:lazy:error
events.description: A region with `ypy-lazy` failed to load (no connection, a status of 400 or more, a swap error). The region has `data-ypy-state="error"`.

config.name: lazy.margin
config.description: How far outside the window a region is loaded, as a CSS margin.
